# ::Requiem

> requiem's corner of cyberspace: a weblog on self-taught development, side projects, mental health and healing, short fiction, plus a photo gallery.

Every weblog entry is a static page under https://requiem.moe/blog/. The full archive with markdown bodies is https://requiem.moe/blog/all.json and the RSS feed is https://requiem.moe/feed.xml.

Every story is a static page under https://requiem.moe/stories/. The full archive with markdown bodies is https://requiem.moe/stories/all.json and the stories feed is https://requiem.moe/stories.xml.
